column3: MT 64:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; בְשִׂיחִי (“my complaint”) is rendered “my meditation,” and “dread” “fear.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֵרִגְשַׁת (“the throng”) is rendered “the rebellion.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “bows to shoot.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְחַזְּקוּ־ (“strengthen”) is rendered “encourage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we have completed a plot well devised” is rendered “We have perfected a shrewd scheme.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV makes God the subject, “He will make them stumble over their own tongue,” and “shudder” is rendered “flee away.”
